description: Evaluation dataset for multi-persona WTA tennis support agent testing tool usage, persona voice, and domain rule compliance across Gina, Gor, Sai, Ma, and Beita.

parts.text: [As Gina] What is my schedule for tomorrow (2026-09-02)?

Daily schedule with breakfast at 07:00, lunch at 12:00, and dinner at 18:00. Explicitly informs Gina that the 06:00 AM breakfast alert is silenced due to Sleep Quiet Hours (22:00 - 07:30) to protect athletic recovery, with daytime alerts active starting after 07:30.

property.description: Agent must explain that early morning alerts (e.g. 06:00 AM for 07:00 AM breakfast) are silenced to protect athlete rest between 22:00 and 07:30.
Agent should acknowledge player persona Gina in an empathetic, supportive tone.

parts.text: [As Gor] Schedule a 2.5 hour serve training session on 2026-09-02 at 14:00
Training request is rejected because 150 minutes exceeds the 120-minute (2-hour) maximum single-session duration limit.

property.description: Agent must reject the session citing the 120-minute (2-hour) maximum limit.

parts.text: [As Gor] Schedule 90-min training on 2026-09-02 at 14:30
Proposes training from 14:30 to 16:00 and notes that Ma's pre-training workout is automatically coupled from 13:30 to 14:30. Presents options [Approve], [Reject], or [Change Time].

property.description: Agent must inform Gor that Ma's workout is auto-scheduled for 13:30-14:30 (1h prior to training).
Agent must present clear confirmation options (such as [Approve] / [Reject]).

parts.text: [As Ma] Workout syllabus for 2026-09-02: Core stability and hip mobility with resistance bands
Confirms attachment of the core stability and hip mobility syllabus to the auto-booked 13:30 workout on 2026-09-02.

property.description: Agent confirms the syllabus has been recorded for the workout session.

parts.text: [As Ma] Meal plan for 2026-09-02: Breakfast oatmeal with berries, lunch grilled chicken quinoa, dinner salmon salad
Confirms daily meal plan and returns a generated food order tracking ID.

property.description: Agent acknowledges the three meals and reports a food delivery order ID.

parts.text: [As Beita] Book sponsor meet-and-greet on 2026-09-02 at 11:00 AM
Rejects the 11:00 AM booking because PR activities cannot be scheduled before court training on the same day. Recommends an open afternoon slot after training (e.g. 16:30 - 17:30).

property.description: Agent must reject the morning slot because PR cannot precede court training.
Agent must offer an alternative afternoon timeslot (e.g. 16:30 or later).

parts.text: [As Gor] Schedule court training on 2026-09-03 at 10:00 AM for 90 minutes
Rejects the training proposal due to the 4-Day Fatigue Guardrail: Gina has trained on 08/30, 08/31, 09/01, and 09/02 consecutively. Recommends mandatory physical rest before the 09/04 match.

property.description: Agent must reject training on 09/03 citing the 4 consecutive active days and need for recovery.

parts.text: [As Sai] Book opponent tactical analysis on 2026-09-03 from 10:30 to 11:30 for Sofia Kenin match
Confirms booking of the 60-minute calendar-blocking opponent scouting session on 09/03 (pre-match day) and attaches tactical game-plan notes.

property.description: Agent confirms scouting session booking on the day prior to the tournament match.

parts.text: [As Gina] What is my schedule for match day (2026-09-04)?

Presents match day schedule including Match vs Kenin (14:00-16:00), Pre-game warm-up (12:30-13:30), Post-game press conference (16:00-16:15), Post-game physical therapy recovery (16:15-17:15), shifted lunch (11:30-12:15) and dinner (18:00-19:00).

property.description: Agent lists Warm-up, Media, and Physical Therapy recovery alongside the official match.
Agent reflects the shifted meal buffer protecting match digestion (1h pre/post-match).

parts.text: [As Beita] Book brand interview on 2026-09-04 at 17:00
Rejects PR booking on match day (2026-09-04) because social and media activities are strictly prohibited to protect match focus.

property.description: Agent must reject the booking citing match day blackout policy.

parts.text: [As Gor] Schedule court training on 2026-09-02 at 16:30 for 60 minutes
Detects conflict with Beita's PR event (16:30-17:30). Informs Gor that Training (Priority 3) has higher priority than PR/Social (Priority 5) and offers the [Approve Override] option.

property.description: Agent detects collision with lower-priority event and provides override capability.
